_comment: THE PER-LANE / PER-PLATFORM HEALTH REGISTRY. Declarative expectations for every gateway lane and every credential-free platform surface, in the same spirit as setup/expected-indexes.json, setup/expected-streams.json and skills/continuity-canary/expected-docs.json: the thing being watched is declared here, the classifier lives in assertions.mjs, and the runner is dumb. Add a lane row to start watching a lane. NOTE the ring design: a lane does NOT declare that the personal-legal rooms are forbidden to it. forbiddenRoomsFor() in assertions.mjs adds personal_legal_rooms to EVERY lane automatically unless that lane is named in personal_legal_ring, so a newly added lane is born forbidden and must be explicitly admitted to the ring. Forgetting to write a forbidden_rooms entry can therefore never silently create an unwatched lane.
_ring_note: PERSONAL_LEGAL_RING is clo-personal and exec ONLY. These rooms hold attorney-privileged personal legal material including a live California family-law matter involving minors. This was a real P0 cross-ring leak once (a cfo-lane brain_search returned both rooms; closed 2026-07-16 by narrowing INDEX_LANES) and nothing has watched it continuously since. Widening this array is a security decision, never a convenience fix.

ledger._note: THE 2026-08-17/18 INCIDENT FLOOR. Gateway commit c72dd3b read the commons brain from otchealth-finance-legal-dr instead of otchealth-brain-dr and found a single stray 725-byte cto.jsonl, so every lane on every platform saw shared_entry_count=1 while the real ~6MB / 29-lane history sat intact at the correct bucket. The call succeeded and returned well-formed JSON the whole time, so only a CONTENT floor catches it. 25 entries / 5 distinct lanes sits far above the corrupt state (1 entry, 1 lane) and far below the real history, so it fires on a misroute without flapping on a quiet day.

lanes.note: cto is deliberately OUTSIDE EXEC_RING: it holds kb_search_privileged and legal_blob_* in its ship-lane toolset but every privileged call refuses (mode=ring-forbidden). Live-verified 2026-08-18: rooms_searched is the two open rooms only.
Same posture as cto: full ship-lane toolset, not in EXEC_RING, two open rooms. Live-verified 2026-08-18.

EXEC_RING member: finance rooms plus company legal. The two personal-legal rooms are added to its forbidden set automatically by policy, and this is the exact lane whose 2026-07-16 P0 leak this canary is watching for a recurrence of.

The company-legal lane, and the single most plausible candidate for an accidental widening into the personal ring since the two room families are one word apart. Correctly excluded as of 2026-08-18; this row is what keeps it that way.

THE RING POSITIVE CONTROL. A ring assertion that only ever checks that rooms are ABSENT will still pass if the personal rooms have silently disappeared from the estate entirely, which is a different outage wearing the same green light. This lane asserts the allow path works: the two personal rooms must be PRESENT here. Ring membership means policy does not add them to its forbidden set.

Non-privileged. Floor is 8 rather than 100 because the documented EXTERNAL_READONLY_TOOLSET is 11 tools by design here, so the ~11-tool connector signature is NOT an anomaly on this lane. Marked optional: whether a client_credentials mint yields the 11-tool set or the full catalog for this lane is not independently proven, so a surprise here should be investigated rather than paged on nightly.

The 2026-08-10 CRO credential fix repointed oauth-lane-cro-id/secret off the occ_cro connector client onto the non-connector CRO client. Its advertised surface is HeyGen-heavy (43 actions observed on the connector form) and it was observed with NO brain-read tool at all, which fails closed and is therefore not a ring violation. expects_brain_search:false records that honestly instead of asserting a room set that may not exist; revisit if the CRO toolset is widened to include the read-only brain tools it is documented to have.

Reachable as an account connector but absent from gateway-connect's LANES table, so a client_credentials mint here will most likely SKIP. Listed so its state is recorded rather than invisible. It is an EXEC_RING member per the ring definition yet is advertised no brain-read tool at all, which is safe-direction but means the seat is brain-blind; that is a known open question, not something to page on nightly.

The second member of the personal-legal ring. No oauth-lane-exec-* credential is known to exist, so this lane is expected to SKIP; it is listed anyway so that the day one IS provisioned, it is watched from the first run instead of being onboarded unmonitored.

platforms.name: gateway_health
platforms.note: The registry floor, not the per-lane floor. A revision that boots with a partially-registered catalog answers /health perfectly happily; only a floor on tool_count catches it. 500 is well under the live 1008 and well over any plausible partial registration.

platforms.name: unauthenticated_mcp_refused
platforms.note: THE FRONT DOOR. An unauthenticated POST must be refused with 401 AND must carry the WWW-Authenticate header that points at the RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata. A regression to 200 here would be an unauthenticated exposure of the entire gateway surface, which is the single worst outcome this file can watch for; the header half separately catches discovery breaking while the door itself still holds.

platforms.name: forged_m365_token_refused
platforms.note: The M365 declarative agents authenticate by a static token in a query parameter rather than a header, which is a materially weaker door than the bearer path and deserves its own continuous proof that it still refuses a value that was never issued.

platforms.name: oauth_protected_resource_metadata
platforms.note: RFC 9728 discovery. If this 404s, every client that follows the WWW-Authenticate pointer above lands nowhere and new connector onboarding breaks with a confusing error far from the cause.

platforms.name: oauth_authorization_server_metadata
platforms.note: The authorization-server metadata every platform seat reads to discover the token and registration endpoints.
